# Lamina PDF

> Lamina PDF creates, reads, edits and saves PDF files from TypeScript and Rust: one Rust core, run as WebAssembly in browsers, Node, Deno, Bun and Cloudflare Workers (`@laminapdf/sdk`), or natively from the `laminapdf` crate. Positions are top-left points of the displayed page and page indexes start at 0; every error has a stable code with its own page.

These docs describe version 0.3.0, the version of this package. The same docs are online at https://docs.laminapdf.com/llms.txt.

- [Using Lamina PDF with coding agents](AGENTS.md)
- [What old names became](renames.json)

- [Lamina PDF](pages/index.md): Create, read, edit and save PDFs from Rust and TypeScript, with one Rust core that runs natively and as WebAssembly.
- [Choosing a PDF library for TypeScript or Rust](pages/start/choosing-a-pdf-library.md): Which PDF library should you use in TypeScript or Rust? What pdf-lib, PDF.js, PDFKit, lopdf, krilla and others do, with sources, and where Lamina PDF fits.
- [Install](pages/install.md): Install Lamina PDF from npm or crates.io, and find every published package.
- [Your first PDF](pages/start/first-pdf.md): Write hello.pdf from Node in five minutes.
- [Your first PDF in Rust](pages/start/first-pdf-rust.md): Write hello.pdf from a Rust program in five minutes.
- [Your first PDF on the command line](pages/start/first-pdf-cli.md): Install the laminapdf command, turn a Markdown file into a PDF, then inspect it and read it back.
- [Use Lamina PDF with coding agents](pages/start/coding-agents.md): Point a coding agent at the docs inside the installed package, so its answers match the version you use.
- [Read offline](pages/start/offline.md): Each section of these docs on one page, and the whole guide as one PDF.

## Your runtime

- [Browser and bundlers](pages/quick-start/browser.md): Load @laminapdf/sdk in a web page through Vite or another bundler.
- [Node](pages/quick-start/node.md): Generate a PDF from Node with @laminapdf/sdk.
- [Deno](pages/quick-start/deno.md): Use @laminapdf/sdk in Deno.
- [Bun](pages/quick-start/bun.md): Use @laminapdf/sdk in Bun.
- [Cloudflare Workers](pages/quick-start/workers.md): Generate PDFs per request in a Cloudflare Worker.
- [Rust](pages/quick-start/rust.md): Generate a PDF with the Lamina PDF crate.

## Concepts

- [How Lamina PDF thinks about a PDF](pages/concepts/how-lamina-thinks.md): Bytes in and out, the same bytes every time, edits kept apart from the opened file, two ways to save, memory you free, three JavaScript modules.
- [Pages and coordinates](pages/concepts/pages-and-coordinates.md): Points from the top-left corner of the page as it's displayed, y going down, and pages numbered from 0.
- [Errors and warnings](pages/concepts/errors-and-warnings.md): One coded error shape on every surface, and warnings for what Lamina PDF repaired.
- [What Lamina PDF writes and what it borrows](pages/concepts/dependencies.md): Lamina PDF writes the parts that decide a PDF's bytes, borrows the rest from permissive projects, and pins and checks everything it borrows.
- [How a page is drawn](pages/concepts/drawing-pages.md): A renderer turns a page into pixels; Lamina PDF reads the page's text, links and selection itself, from the same bytes.

## Create PDFs

- [Text and fonts](pages/guides/fonts-and-text.md): Draw text in any script with your own fonts or the standard 14, one line at a time or as a paragraph that wraps in a box.
- [Shapes, colour and images](pages/guides/images-and-vectors.md): Draw lines, shapes and images on a page, in any colour, with transparency, clipping and transforms.
- [Links, outlines and metadata](pages/guides/links-outlines-and-metadata.md): Add links, named destinations, an outline, page labels, viewer preferences and metadata to a document.
- [Pages that flow](pages/guides/flowing-pages.md): Pour headings, paragraphs, tables and images, or a Markdown file, into as many pages as they need, with footnotes, a contents page and "Page X of Y" footers.
- [Accessible PDFs](pages/guides/accessible-pdfs.md): Build PDF/UA-1 documents that screen readers can follow, with every machine-checkable rule checked when the builder finishes.
- [Archival PDFs](pages/guides/archival-pdfs.md): Build PDF/A-2b, PDF/A-2u and PDF/A-3b documents that look the same in years to come, and attach files such as an e-invoice's XML.

## Read and edit PDFs

- [Edit a PDF](pages/guides/edit-a-pdf.md): Change an existing PDF in transactions you can undo, and replay edits stored as JSON.
- [Save a PDF](pages/guides/save-a-pdf.md): Save edits as a revision appended to the original bytes or as a whole new file, and see when a file refuses a save.
- [Extract text and Markdown](pages/guides/extract-text.md): Get a PDF's text out in reading order as plain text, Markdown, JSON with a box for every block, or chunks for retrieval, in TypeScript and Rust.
- [Open password-protected files](pages/guides/password-protected-files.md): Open PDFs that need a password, ask again when it is missing or wrong, and save them afterwards.
- [Open files you don't trust](pages/guides/untrusted-files.md): Cap how much work an uploaded PDF can make Lamina PDF do, and refuse damaged files with strict mode.
- [Open large files by ranges](pages/guides/open-large-files.md): Open a PDF on a web server without downloading all of it, fetching only the byte ranges each read needs.
- [Check what a file hides](pages/guides/check-what-a-file-hides.md): Find what a PDF holds beyond its visible pages, from earlier revisions to hidden text, and redactions that only covered text instead of removing it.

## Show PDFs

- [Show a PDF in a web page](pages/guides/show-a-pdf.md): Put a scrolling, zoomable PDF viewer in your page with @laminapdf/viewer, drawn by PDFium in a Web Worker.
- [Render pages to images](pages/guides/render-pages.md): Draw a PDF's pages as pixels, for thumbnails, previews or tests, in JavaScript and from the command line.

## Command line

- [The command line](pages/cli.md): Inspect, check, extract, render and build PDFs from a terminal, a build script or an AI agent with the laminapdf command.
- [Install the command-line tool](pages/cli/install.md): Install the laminapdf command with Homebrew or npm, or download it for macOS, Linux or Windows and check it against its checksum.
- [Inspect and check PDFs](pages/cli/inspect.md): Describe a PDF with laminapdf info, find what Lamina PDF had to repair with check, and list what a file holds beyond its pages with reveal.
- [Extract text and render pages](pages/cli/extract-and-render.md): Read a PDF's text, or its blocks in reading order as Markdown, JSON or chunks for an LLM, and draw its pages as PNG images from the command line.
- [Make and change PDFs](pages/cli/build-and-edit.md): Turn Markdown or a JSON document into a tagged, accessible PDF with laminapdf build, and turn pages with laminapdf pages rotate.
- [Scripts and batch jobs](pages/cli/scripts.md): Pipe PDFs through laminapdf, name pages with ranges, check thousands of files in parallel, and read its JSON reports and exit codes from a script.
- [Connect an AI agent (MCP)](pages/cli/mcp.md): Serve the laminapdf commands as tools for Claude and other AI agents over the Model Context Protocol, limited to the folders you choose.

## Production

- [Keep the page responsive](pages/guides/keep-the-page-responsive.md): Run Lamina PDF in a Web Worker with @laminapdf/sdk/worker, so a large file never freezes the page.
- [Test the PDFs you generate](pages/guides/test-generated-pdfs.md): Compare the PDFs your code makes with reference PDFs you approved, byte for byte, and draw both files' pages to see what changed.

## Recipes

- [Recipes](pages/recipes.md): Complete Lamina PDF programs, from one page of text to an archived invoice, each with its code and the PDF it writes.
- [Hello, world](pages/recipes/hello.md): One A4 page with a line of text in a standard 14 font, the smallest PDF Lamina PDF writes, in TypeScript and Rust.
- [An invoice](pages/recipes/invoice.md): A tagged one-page invoice with an embedded font, a table of line items with right-aligned amounts and a total, in TypeScript and Rust.
- [Fill an invoice from JSON](pages/recipes/invoice-from-json.md): An invoice template written as JSON and filled from data, its line items repeated into a table that runs across pages, in Rust and TypeScript.
- [Turn Markdown into a PDF](pages/recipes/markdown-to-pdf.md): A report written in Markdown, as tagged pages that flow, from the command line, TypeScript or Rust, with tables, footnotes, images and a contents page.
- [Multilingual text](pages/recipes/multilingual.md): Latin, Arabic, Devanagari, Hebrew and Chinese on one page, each in its own embedded font, as a shaped line and a wrapped paragraph.
- [Images and vectors](pages/recipes/images-and-vectors.md): Shapes, a dashed curve, gray, RGB, CMYK and hex colour, transparency, a blend mode, a clip, a rotation, a JPEG and an RGBA image on one page.
- [Turn photos into a PDF](pages/recipes/images-to-pdf.md): Photos into a PDF, one page each, fitted on A4 with margins, in TypeScript or Rust, with each JPEG embedded as it is.
- [Element flow](pages/recipes/element-flow.md): A report whose title, paragraphs and photo each start below wherever the one before ended, with a body that continues on a new page.
- [Links and outlines](pages/recipes/links-and-outlines.md): Four A5 pages joined by web, page and named links, with a nested outline, page labels that read i, ii, 1, 2 and the outline shown on open.
- [Generate, then edit](pages/recipes/generate-then-edit.md): Build a one-page draft, open its bytes, retitle it in one transaction and save the edit as a revision after the original bytes.
- [Edit the metadata](pages/recipes/edit-metadata.md): Change a PDF's title, authors and keywords in both of the places a PDF keeps them, check the save first, and stamp when it happened.
- [Choose how a PDF opens](pages/recipes/set-initial-view.md): Set the page and zoom a PDF opens at, the panel beside it and the title in the window, for Lamina PDF and every other PDF reader.
- [Edit the bookmarks](pages/recipes/edit-bookmarks.md): Add, move and style a PDF's bookmarks, name a place links can jump to, and rename a destination together with everything that uses it.
- [Record your own metadata](pages/recipes/edit-xmp.md): Add properties of your own to a PDF's XMP metadata, such as a review's status and reviewers, and keep a PDF/A file valid while you do.
- [Organise pages](pages/recipes/organise-pages.md): Delete, move, insert and rotate a PDF's pages in one edit, and see where the bookmarks and links that pointed at a deleted page now go.
- [Duplicate pages](pages/recipes/duplicate-pages.md): Copy a page within a PDF so the copy has form fields of its own, and see what the copy renamed and left out.
- [Copy pages between PDFs](pages/recipes/copy-pages.md): Copy pages from another PDF into this one, replace a page with one from another file, or make a new PDF from some pages.
- [Merge and split PDFs](pages/recipes/merge-and-split.md): Merge several PDFs into one with a bookmark for each file, or split a PDF into one file per chapter.
- [Extract text for an LLM](pages/recipes/extract-markdown.md): Turn a PDF into Markdown in reading order, JSON with a box for every block, and chunks sized for retrieval, in TypeScript and Rust.
- [A PDF/UA report](pages/recipes/pdf-ua-report.md): A one-page sales report a screen reader can follow, with headings, a table, a described chart and a link, checked against PDF/UA-1 as it's built.
- [A PDF/A archive](pages/recipes/pdf-a-archive.md): An order confirmation for long-term archiving, written as PDF/A-2b and as PDF/A-2u that is also PDF/UA-1, with an embedded font and a photo.
- [A PDF/A-3 invoice with XML](pages/recipes/pdf-a3-invoice-with-xml.md): A PDF/A-3b invoice that carries the same invoice as an attached XML file, for people to read and for software to process.
- [A 100-page report](pages/recipes/report.md): A 100-page A4 report with two embedded fonts and a table on every page, the document Lamina PDF times in each JavaScript runtime.
- [Open someone else's file](pages/recipes/open-untrusted.md): Open an uploaded PDF with an optional password and tighter limits, and get its page count and warnings, or the error, back as a value.
- [Save in a Web Worker](pages/recipes/web-worker-client.md): Open and save a PDF in a Web Worker, so a large file never freezes the page, with progress as it saves and a signal that stops the work.
- [A Cloudflare Worker](pages/recipes/cloudflare-worker.md): A Cloudflare Worker that returns a one-page letter per request, in a standard 14 font or a bundled one, and a 400 for a name the font can't draw.

## Troubleshooting

- [Troubleshooting](pages/troubleshooting.md): Find the fix for what you see when Lamina PDF goes wrong, whether you use it from JavaScript, Rust or the command line, or to extract text or render pages.
- [Troubleshooting JavaScript and TypeScript](pages/troubleshooting/javascript.md): The problems people hit with @laminapdf/sdk, from a missing init() to a bundler that loses the WebAssembly, with the cause and the fix of each.
- [Troubleshooting Rust](pages/troubleshooting/rust.md): Fixes for the laminapdf crate when Cargo picks the wrong version, a feature is missing, or your Rust is too old.
- [Troubleshooting the command line](pages/troubleshooting/command-line.md): Fixes for the laminapdf tool when a script stops on exit 3, a file already exists, a password is needed or a PDF would go to the terminal.
- [Troubleshooting opening and saving files](pages/troubleshooting/files.md): Fixes for files that need a password, signed files that won't save, and files over a limit, from JavaScript, Rust or the command line.
- [Troubleshooting text extraction](pages/troubleshooting/extraction.md): Fixes for extracted text that comes out empty, in the wrong order, with missing characters, or without its headers and footers.
- [Troubleshooting rendering](pages/troubleshooting/rendering.md): Fixes for rendering pages when PDFium isn't found, an image is too large, a page draws wrong, or laminapdf render refuses its output names.

- [Benchmarks](pages/reference/benchmarks.md): How fast Lamina PDF makes PDFs in each runtime, how large its WebAssembly files are, and how well it extracts text on a public benchmark.

- [Glossary](pages/reference/glossary.md): The PDF and Lamina PDF terms the docs use, each in a sentence or two.
